tweet.text:
The three virtues of using Grok @Bot well:

• Laziness: The quality that makes you go to great effort to reduce overall energy expenditure. It makes you question "how can a bot do this instead of me?"
• Impatience: Instead of asking "should we do this?", you use @bot to build it yourself and share a PR or feature flag
• Hubris: The quality that makes you own the outcome even when you didn't make it with your own hands
